name: How long does a typical site feasibility consultation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical site feasibility consultation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a site feasibility consultation can vary depending on the complexity of the property and the depth of the assessment required. Generally, an on-site visit and initial discussion can take anywhere from one to two hours. Following the visit, additional time is spent on research and report generation, compiling all the findings regarding zoning, utilities, and other relevant factors. We aim to provide a comprehensive overview in a timely manner.
acceptedAnswer.description: An on-site visit typically takes 1-2 hours, followed by additional time for research and report generation.
